name: threadline starter pack
summary: GELF input pre-configured for the threadline project (Vector agents ship here).
description: Sets up the GELF UDP/12201 input that every threadline agent (Vector) ships logs and EDR alerts to. Pipelines, the MISP lookup table, and dashboards are documented as a short guided setup in README.md#post-install-graylog-setup because their exact JSON schema is more version-sensitive than a plain input -- importing a stale schema silently breaks more than it helps. Re-export this pack from your own Graylog (System > Content Packs > Export) once you've built out pipelines/dashboards you like, to replace this file for future installs.
